scope: Single request-bound verification plan integrity and turn-local completion
changes: Bound each Single VerificationPlan to both the current unique turn_id and the user prompt digest; added a backward-compatible SQLite migration for the turn identity.
Made a registered plan immutable within a turn and require registration before the first workspace write, preventing prompt replay and post-result verification downgrade.
Required each plan requirement to name covered user acceptance points; made all verifier resource fields explicitly required in the tool schema.
Registered verification_plan as a built-in read-class control tool so it does not fall through to high-risk execute approval.
Kept later ordinary replies at response_complete when only prior-turn unaccepted code exists, unless the user starts a fresh request-bound verification turn.
Updated the architecture document and added regression test source for old-plan replay and historical candidate isolation.
